title: Stop the backtest from seeing the future
description: Choose a decision, feature join, and validation gap. The workbench exposes which fields truly existed at decision time and whether the evaluation is separated from its delayed outcome.

scenarios.label: Card authorization
scenarios.detail: Decide whether to approve, challenge, or review a payment while the customer waits.

features.label: Account tenure snapshot
features.explanation: A versioned customer attribute already present before authorization.

features.label: One-hour payment velocity
features.explanation: A bounded aggregate computed only from transactions observed by the scoring deadline.

features.label: Merchant risk snapshot
features.explanation: The score version and its publication time precede the authorization.

features.label: Manual review disposition
features.explanation: A reviewer outcome is useful as a later label signal, not as an authorization feature.

features.label: Chargeback filed
features.explanation: This delayed outcome would make the historical row easy to classify but was unknowable at T0.

scenarios.label: Credit application
scenarios.detail: Decide whether to approve, decline, or route an application for review.
scenarios.targetLabel: Performance over the defined repayment window

features.label: Declared income at application
features.explanation: The submitted value and verification state are versioned with the application.

features.label: Bureau snapshot
features.explanation: Use the report received for this decision, not a bureau record refreshed later.

features.label: Existing exposure
features.explanation: A ledger snapshot known before the application decision.

features.label: Final decision code
features.explanation: The policy output is caused by the scoring path and cannot be an input to that same decision.

features.label: First-payment outcome
features.explanation: A future repayment event belongs to labeling and monitoring, never the application feature view.

scenarios.label: Intraday order decision
scenarios.detail: Choose whether and how much to trade before the next market event is known.
scenarios.targetLabel: Realized return after costs over one day

features.label: Best bid and ask
features.explanation: A feed event is eligible only after it reaches the strategy through the production path.

features.label: Current position
features.explanation: The pre-order position and limit usage are available to the risk check.

features.label: Prior session close
features.explanation: A completed prior-session value is safe when the corporate-action version is preserved.

features.label: Final execution price
features.explanation: The fill depends on the order and market response, so it cannot inform the pre-trade prediction.

features.label: Next session close
features.explanation: This future price helps define the target but must remain outside every training feature row.
